title: A community legal/financial fine-tune of gemma3:270m, measured on the standard fixture
goal: Measure nagbhaskar55/gemma-3-270m-bhaskar-finetune (FORBIDDEN.md's third bounded-rewriter checkpoint, permitted 2026-10-16) on the identical 13-finding fixture and both leaf sizes every other rewriter exploration used, through the new model-agnostic rewrite_unit (lab.common.rewriter_backends) -- testing whether someone else's larger-scale legal-domain fine-tune fixes what EXP-073's own from-scratch LoRA attempt could not.
method: Identical 13 findings (8 claims, 5 paragraphs) and leaf-size-1 split as EXP-048/054/056/062/063, plus the identical first-4-findings leaf as EXP-064, run through lab.common.rewriter_backends.rewrite_unit(checkpoint='nagbhaskar55/gemma-3-270m-bhaskar-finetune') -- raw, no post-hoc splice or decoding constraint, for a fair first measurement against the other checkpoints' own first (raw) measurements.

model_card.role: rewriter only (ARCHITECTURE.md section 3.7): join verified findings into prose
model_card.fine_tuned_by: a third party (nagbhaskar55), not this project -- a community checkpoint, not Google's own, measured here rather than trusted from its own model card
model_card.training_data_per_card: 7,617 synthetic legal/financial instruction examples (US case law, SEC filings, educational web text); 1,560 of them explicitly 'rewriting'

results_prose: Leaf size 1 (13 findings, raw, no splice/constraint repair): fidelity pass rate 0.0. Fail reasons: {'nli': 9, 'citations': 13, 'numbers': 1, 'modal': 3}. Leaf size 4 (the original hard case): failed, reasons ['numbers', 'nli', 'citations']. For comparison on the identical fixture: flan-t5-small 0.3846, gemma3:270m via Ollama raw 0.0 (spliced 0.8462, decoding-constrained 1.0).
conclusion: This checkpoint's failures are not purely a citation-formatting gap -- see fail_reason_counts; a different repair strategy would be needed, reported as measured rather than assumed to match EXP-063's pattern. On the original 4-fact leaf specifically, it still fails -- legal-domain training-distribution match alone did not fix multi-fact synthesis the way the project owner's hypothesis (EXP-073's finding) suggested it might, at least not without the same repair layer the single-fact case needs.
scale_down: Same 13 findings as every other rewriter exploration, one checkpoint, raw generation only (no splice/constraint repair applied yet).
follow_ups: If the citation-marker gap is the only failure mode (as EXP-063's identical pattern suggests), apply the same post-hoc splice or decoding-constrained approach and remeasure.

Not yet tested: whether this checkpoint's chat-template prompting (vs. the plain-string prompting flan-t5-small/gemma3:270m-via-Ollama use) itself affects fidelity independent of the checkpoint's own fine-tuning -- a confound this exploration doesn't isolate.
models_used: nagbhaskar55/gemma-3-270m-bhaskar-finetune (base google/gemma-3-270m-it), a third-party fine-tune, measured not trusted. Rewriter role only, same fidelity gate as every other checkpoint in this repo.
